title: Slash × AppLovin: Earn Up to 5% Cashback on Your Ad Spend
summary: Pay for AppLovin ads with a Slash Visa Platinum Card and earn 5% cashback on eligible spend, plus dedicated cards and limits for every campaign.
body_markdown:
## Get 5% Cashback on AppLovin Ad Spend with Slash


Your AppLovin campaigns already drive growth. Now they can earn more cashback, too.


Businesses that pay for AppLovin ads with a secured Slash Visa Platinum Card¹ can now earn 5% cashback on eligible ad spend. New Slash customers may also qualify for up to 50K AppLovin credits at signup. See offer details below.


## More return from your most valuable campaigns


[AppLovin Ads](https://www.applovin.com/) places your ads inside mobile apps and games and optimizes delivery toward the results you set, like purchases or installs. Putting each campaign on its own card shows you exactly what each campaign costs and keeps an overspending test from eating into the budget behind your best performers.


Paying with a card that earns 5% on AppLovin spend means the budget you scale into a winning campaign earns more back as it grows.


With Slash, you can give each ad campaign its own dedicated card and account. Set a low limit on campaigns in testing and raise it once one starts performing. Merchant locks restrict each card to AppLovin charges, and every transaction posts to your Slash dashboard in real time.


## Corporate cards built for control


Cashback, automation, and insights, simplified.


[Get Started](https://www.slash.com/sales-inquiry)


## How it works


To access the Slash x Applovin offer:


1. Ask your Slash account representative to activate the offer.
2. Set up an AppLovin account through Slash's sign-up link.
3. Pay AppLovin directly for advertising with your Slash Visa Platinum Card.


The offer is only available to companies with a Slash Account and a secured Slash Platinum Card in good standing. The 5% promotional rate replaces the standard cashback rate that would otherwise apply to the transaction. Purchases made before you activate the offer do not earn elevated cashback.


## Get started with Slash to scale your next campaign


Along with the AppLovin offer, the Slash Visa Platinum Card earns up to 2% cash back on eligible business spend, and Slash customers get access to more than $1M in discounts and credits from over 100 partners.


Don’t have Slash yet? Fill out the form below to get started.


## Apply in less than 10 minutes today


Join the 10,000+ businesses already using Slash.


*Terms and eligibility requirements apply. The offer may be modified, suspended, or terminated in accordance with the applicable offer terms. For full eligibility requirements, exclusions, and redemption details, see the[Offer Terms](https://www.slash.com/legal/slash-applovin-cashback-offer-terms) .*
